title: Only part of this AI wakes up
hook: Only part of this AI wakes up

beats.say: Some of the biggest AI models only use a small slice of their brain for each word.
It's called mixture of experts. Inside are many smaller expert networks, plus a router.
For every token, the router picks just two experts to do the work.
Different tokens, different experts. Everything else stays asleep.
Mixtral, for example, has about forty seven billion parameters, but uses only about thirteen billion per token.
Huge knowledge, small compute bill. That's why so many new models are built this way.

caption: Mixture of experts (MoE): the model holds many expert sub-networks, and a router sends each token to just a few of them. Mixtral 8x7B has ~47B parameters but uses ~13B per token (2 of 8 experts). You get the knowledge of a big model at the compute cost of a much smaller one.
sources: Mistral AI, Mixtral of Experts (2024): 46.7B total, 12.9B active, top-2 of 8 experts
